summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor (buffers only when is_terminal, returns that result, with the required docstring); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200; tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not verified: tests and mypy were not run, per instructions. Possible concern: set_window_title also respects the dumb-terminal check through Console.control, so it can return false-negative-style behavior versus the spec's wording; flagged for the user to confirm.
